items.title: Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: 2.0% Salicylic Acid for Breakouts and Signs of Aging
items.lead: Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: an active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging.
items.hook: an active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging.
facts: Active two-in-one serum that clears and helps prevent breakouts while reducing visible signs of skin aging (30 ml)
Salicylic acid 2.0%; niacinamide is second on the ingredient list, right after water
Niacinamide with white shiitake mushroom for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone
AGE Bright Complex works with the skin's natural microbiome; resurrection plant phytoactives hydrate and smooth
Apply a thin layer, allow to dry, use under moisturizer up to twice a day as needed
Sensitive skin: build up to daily use; sensitive to salicylic acid: patch test first or avoid

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Clearing Serum
scenes.say: Dealing with breakouts and early signs of aging at the same time? Today we're looking at the Dermalogica AGE Bright Clearing Serum: what it does, what's in it, and how to use it.

scenes.caption: Clears + helps prevent
scenes.say: This is an active two-in-one serum. It clears and helps prevent breakouts, while reducing visible signs of skin aging.

scenes.caption: Salicylic acid 2.0%
scenes.say: The active ingredient is salicylic acid, at two point zero percent.

scenes.caption: Niacinamide
scenes.say: Niacinamide comes second on the ingredient list, right after water.

scenes.caption: White shiitake mushroom
scenes.say: Niacinamide is paired with white shiitake mushroom, for a brighter, more even-looking skin tone.

scenes.caption: AGE Bright Complex
scenes.say: The AGE Bright Complex works with the skin's natural microbiome.

scenes.caption: Resurrection plant
scenes.say: And phytoactives from the resurrection plant help hydrate and smooth the skin.

scenes.caption: 30 ml
scenes.say: The serum comes in a thirty milliliter bottle, and a ten milliliter mini is part of the Active Clearing Kit.

scenes.caption: After cleansing
scenes.say: So how do you use it? After cleansing, apply a thin layer, and allow it to dry.

scenes.caption: Under moisturizer
scenes.say: Then follow with your moisturizer. Use it up to twice a day, as needed.

scenes.caption: Sensitive skin
scenes.say: If your skin is sensitive, build up to daily use. If you're sensitive to salicylic acid, patch test first, or avoid it.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: To recap: two point zero percent salicylic acid, niacinamide with white shiitake, and a thin layer under your moisturizer, up to twice a day. The link is in the description.

items.title: Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30: Matte SPF Moisturizer for Breakout-Prone Skin
items.lead: Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF30: a shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress, with a long-lasting matte finish.
items.hook: a shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress, with a long-lasting matte finish.
facts: Shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress (59 ml)
Broad spectrum SPF30; active filters homosalate 8%, octocrylene 8%, octisalate 5%, avobenzone 3%
Natural tapioca helps reduce shine for a long-lasting matte finish
Willow bark extract, green tea extract and vitamin C help combat the irritating effects of pollution
Apply a generous amount to cleansed face and neck, preferably 30 minutes before sun exposure; reapply as recommended
Very dry skin may feel drier; layer a hydrating lotion underneath

scenes.caption: Clearing Defense SPF30
scenes.say: If your skin is breakout-prone and gets shiny, this one is for you. It's the Dermalogica Clearing Defense SPF thirty. Let's go through what it is, what's in it, and how to apply it.

scenes.caption: SPF moisturizer
scenes.say: It's a shine-reducing SPF moisturizer that helps protect breakout-prone skin from environmental stress. One step that moisturizes and protects.

scenes.caption: Long-lasting matte finish
scenes.say: It leaves a long-lasting matte finish.

scenes.caption: Broad spectrum SPF30
scenes.say: It's broad spectrum SPF thirty, so it defends against UV rays.

scenes.caption: Homosalate + octocrylene
scenes.say: The active sun filters are homosalate at eight percent and octocrylene at eight percent.

scenes.caption: Octisalate + avobenzone
scenes.say: Plus octisalate at five percent, and avobenzone at three percent.

scenes.caption: Natural tapioca
scenes.say: Natural tapioca helps reduce shine. That's where the matte finish comes from.

scenes.caption: Willow bark + green tea
scenes.say: Willow bark extract, green tea extract and vitamin C help combat the irritating effects of pollution.

scenes.caption: Generous amount
scenes.say: To use it, apply a generous amount to your cleansed face and neck, preferably thirty minutes before sun exposure.

scenes.caption: Reapply
scenes.say: Reapply as recommended. It comes in a fifty-nine milliliter tube.

scenes.caption: Very dry skin?
scenes.say: If your skin is very dry, this mattifying formula may feel drying, so layer a hydrating lotion underneath.

scenes.caption: Recap
scenes.say: That's the Clearing Defense SPF thirty: broad spectrum, a matte finish, and made for breakout-prone skin. The link is in the description.
